basic_details.job_title: UoH Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on temporary basis in an ANRF-sponsored project, "Functionalized Bronzaphyrins - A Novel Class of 26π Hexaphyrin(2.0.0.2.0.0): Potential Dyes For Shortwave Infrared (SWIR) Imaging & Photothermal Therapy (PTT)". The post needs first class in M.Sc. (General/Inorganic/Organic Chemistry) and GATE, and the pay is consolidated as per ANRF norms. The tenure is initially one year, extendable till the project ends in May 2031. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 5:30 P.M. on

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is in a project run by Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda, Principal Investigator, at the School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, a Central University at Hyderabad. The project title refers to functionalized bronzaphyrins as potential dyes for SWIR imaging and Photothermal Therapy. The funding agency named in the notice is ANRF.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: One JRF post is open. The notice prints these conditions for it: The notice adds that the selected candidate can register for Ph. D. as per University of Hyderabad norms. Candidates should see the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: First class in M.Sc. (General/Inorganic/Organic Chemistry); GATE
rows.desirable: Experience in Porphyrinoid chemistry will be preferred

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay per month is "As per ANRF norms"; the notice prints no amount. The position is on temporary basis. The project duration is initially one year and may be extended till the end of the project (May 2031).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed curriculum vitae, your certificates and the GATE qualified letter original. Prepare your application and combine everything in a single pdf file. Email it to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches by 5:30 P.M. on 26 November 2026. The Principal Investigator's postal address, as printed: Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda, School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, Central University P. O., Hyderabad 500 046. Phone: +91-40-23134818 (O). Fax: +91-40-23012460.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email by 27 November 2026 for an online interview on 30 November 2026 at 10:30 A.M. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or the interview content.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in the UoH ANRF project?
faq.answer: There is one JRF post, on temporary basis, in the ANRF-sponsored project at the School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: The application must reach [email protected] by 5:30 P.M. on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need first class in M.Sc. (General/Inorganic/Organic Chemistry) and GATE. Experience in Porphyrinoid chemistry will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay per month is as per ANRF norms. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: Send your detailed curriculum vitae, certificates and GATE qualified letter original by email to [email protected], along with the application in a single pdf file.

faq.question: Q6. When is the UoH JRF interview?
faq.answer: The online interview is on 30 November 2026 at 10:30 A.M. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the UoH JRF project tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is initially one year. It may be extended till the end of the project (May 2031).

faq.question: Q8. Can the JRF register for a Ph. D. at the University of Hyderabad?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the candidate can register for Ph. D. as per University of Hyderabad norms.
